title: High Availability by Layer — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Multi-Zone Power Outage: demonstrates cross-zone failover resilience and automated capacity rebalancing.
routing_rationale: Testing complete zone loss proves that regional topologies can sustain 33% physical capacity loss without degrading customer experience.

nodes.label: Zone A Instances (Dead)
nodes.detail: Physical substation transformer failure drops all servers in us-central1-a.

nodes.label: Zone B Instances (Healthy)
nodes.detail: Absorbs 50% of redirected traffic; autoscaler provisions additional nodes.

nodes.label: Zone C Instances (Healthy)
nodes.detail: Absorbs remaining 50% of redirected traffic with zero dropped transactions.

steps.title: Zonal Evacuation
steps.action: Regional load balancer immediately routes all traffic away from dead Zone A into Zones B and C.
steps.why_traversal: Regional architecture absorbs zonal catastrophes seamlessly.

scenarios.label: Capacity Starvation in Surviving Zones
scenarios.root_cause: Cluster was running at 90% utilization before outage; surviving zones hit CPU saturation.
scenarios.diverted_path: Latency spikes from 25ms to 4,200ms; requests queue and timeout.
scenarios.recovery: Maintain N+1 capacity headroom: never exceed 66% baseline CPU utilization in a 3-zone regional cluster.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
